full goroutine stack dump

Profile Descriptions:

  • allocs:
    A sampling of all past memory allocations
  • block:
    Stack traces that led to blocking on synchronization primitives
  • cmdline:
    The command line invocation of the current program
  • goroutine:
    Stack traces of all current goroutines. Use debug=2 as a query parameter to export in the same format as an unrecovered panic.
  • heap:
    A sampling of memory allocations of live objects. You can specify the gc GET parameter to run GC before taking the heap sample.
  • mutex:
    Stack traces of holders of contended mutexes
  • profile:
    CPU profile. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the profile file, use the go tool pprof command to investigate the profile.
  • threadcreate:
    Stack traces that led to the creation of new OS threads
  • trace:
    A trace of execution of the current program. You can specify the duration in the seconds GET parameter. After you get the trace file, use the go tool trace command to investigate the trace.

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

if not "%1"=="NOPAUSE" pause

#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
##exit
##eeooff
##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
##    do
##        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  sleep 5
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@172.16.62.78:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash -x

# If a bundle file is present, call tox with the jenkins version of
# the test environment so it is used.  Otherwise, use the normal
# (non-bundle) test environment.  Also, run pbr freeze on the
# resulting environment at the end so that we have a record of exactly
# what packages we ended up testing.
#
# Usage: run-tox.sh VENV
#
# Where VENV is the name of the tox environment to run (specified in the
# project's tox.ini file).

venv=$1
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

if [[ -z "$venv" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $?"
    echo
    echo "VENV: The tox environment to run (eg 'python27')"
    exit 1
fi

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}

function freeze_venv {
    [ -e $bin_path/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

    echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
    echo "======================================================================"
    ${bin_path}/${freezecmd} freeze | sort -f
    echo "======================================================================"
}

function process_testr_artifacts {
    if [ ! -d ".testrepository" ] ; then
        return
    fi

    if [ -f ".testrepository/0.2" ] ; then
        cp .testrepository/0.2 ./testrepository.subunit
    elif [ -f ".testrepository/0" ] ; then
        $bin_path/testr last --subunit > ./testrepository.subunit
    fi
    #/usr/bin/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    $bin_path/subunit2html ./testrepository.subunit testr_results.html
    SUBUNIT_SIZE=$(du -k ./testrepository.subunit | awk '{print $1}')
    gzip -9 ./testrepository.subunit
    gzip -9 ./testr_results.html

    if [[ "$SUBUNIT_SIZE" -gt 50000 ]]; then
        echo
        echo "testrepository.subunit was > 50 MB of uncompressed data!!!"
        echo "Something is causing tests for this project to log significant amounts"
        echo "of data. This may be writers to python logging, stdout, or stderr."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi

    rancount=$($bin_path/testr last | sed -ne 's/Ran \([0-9]\+\).*tests in.*//p')
    if [ -z "$rancount" ] || [ "$rancount" -eq "0" ] ; then
        echo
        echo "Zero tests were run. At least one test should have been run."
        echo "Failing this test as a result"
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_sudo_usage {
    sudo $script_path/jenkins-sudo-grep.sh post
    sudoresult=$?

    if [ $sudoresult -ne "0" ]; then
        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to execute commands"
        echo "with sudo.  See above for the exact commands used."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_oom {
    $script_path/jenkins-oom-grep.sh post
    oomresult=$?

    if [ $oomresult -ne "0" ]; then
        echo
        echo "This test has failed because it attempted to exceed configured"
        echo "memory limits and was killed prior to completion.  See above"
        echo "for related kernel messages."
        echo
        exit 1
    fi
}

function check_nose_html {
    htmlreport=$(find . -name $NOSE_HTML_OUT_FILE)
    if [ -f "$htmlreport" ]; then
        passcount=$(grep -c 'tr class=.passClass' $htmlreport)
        if [ $passcount -eq "0" ]; then
            echo
            echo "Zero tests passed, which probably means there was an error"
            echo "parsing one of the python files, or that some other failure"
            echo "during test setup prevented a sane run."
            echo
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
}


script_path=/usr/local/jenkins/slave_scripts
bin_path=.tox/$venv/bin

export PYTHON=$bin_path/python
export NOSE_WITH_XUNIT=1
export NOSE_WITH_HTML_OUTPUT=1
export NOSE_HTML_OUT_FILE='nose_results.html'
if [[ -z "$TMPDIR" ]]; then
    export TMPDIR=$(/bin/mktemp -d)
fi
trap "rm -rf $TMPDIR" EXIT

export_upper_constratints_file

#cat /etc/image-hostname.txt

#$script_path/jenkins-oom-grep.sh pre

#sudo $script_path/jenkins-sudo-grep.sh pre

tox -v -e$venv
result=$?

freeze_venv
process_testr_artifacts
#check_sudo_usage
#check_oom
check_nose_html

# Rename tox' .log files to .log.txt so that Apache serves them as
# text/plain files since it can handle .txt special - and .log is
# unknown and therefore served as binary.
find .tox -type f -name "*.log" -exec mv {} {}.txt \;

exit $result

# Android kernel
## Compilation
The Android kernel source code is located in the `BST-C1200-LINUX-SDK-Vx.x.x.x-Release/opensource_code` directory as `kernel_android_xxxxxxxxx.tar.gz`. Refer to the [SDK installation](../../quickstart_en/sdk_userguide/sdk-install.md) section for instructions on installing container image dependencies. After setting up the FDK, DDK, and SDK container development environment, copy the source code archive into the container and execute the following commands to compile:

```shell
source /opt/bstos/linux-25/environment-setup-aarch64-bst-linux
./make_c1200_android.sh
```

The generated image, dtb, and defconfig files are located at:

```shell
build/arch/arm64/boot/Image
build/arch/arm64/boot/dts/bst/bstc1200-ivi.dtb
arch/arm64/configs/bstc1200_ivi_defconfig
```

**Note: The image generated here is only the Android kernel image. To generate a complete IVI system image, you need to download the Android code from the developer website and copy the three generated files to the corresponding locations in the Android code project for image compilation.**

#!/bin/bash -x

# If a bundle file is present, call tox with the jenkins version of
# the test environment so it is used.  Otherwise, use the normal
# (non-bundle) test environment.  Also, run pbr freeze on the
# resulting environment at the end so that we have a record of exactly
# what packages we ended up testing.
#
# Usage: run-tox.sh VENV
#
# Where VENV is the name of the tox environment to run (specified in the
# project's tox.ini file).

venv=$1
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

if [[ -z "$venv" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $?"
    echo
    echo "VENV: The tox environment to run (eg 'python27')"
    exit 1

#!/bin/bash -xe
# The script is jenkins job to compile rpm packages for fitos.
# Jenkins Parameters:
# $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH: the branch for repository manifest
# $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE: incremental compile or not
# $PKG_LIST: package targets list to compile, empty to compile all
# $FH_DATE: compile time formated yyyyMMdd_HHmm
# Such as: http://10.132.3.10:8080/view/FitOS-CD/job/fitos-compile-rpm/
# The script must be executed at compile machine, such as 10.127.2.26

source /usr/local/bin/finishSetup.sh
openEuler_RPM_code=()

openEuler_RPM_spec=()

tis_patch_ver=`date +"%y%m%d"`
_tis_dist=.fitos.v5r2m3


if [ ! $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE ]; then
  INCREMENTAL_COMPILE=false
fi

if [[ $INCREMENTAL_COMPILE == false ]]; then
  # clean dir
  sudo rm -rf $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
  sudo rm -rf $MY_WORKSPACE
  mkdir -p $MY_REPO
  mkdir -p $MY_WORKSPACE

  # init repo manifest
  cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
  repo init -u ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/manifest.git -b $FITOS_GIT_BRANCH -m default.xml --repo-url=ssh://git@10.132.3.7/fitcloud/git-repo.git --no-repo-verify
fi

cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR || exit 1
repo sync

#Insert CPU_ARCH to all spec files
if [ ! $CPU_ARCH ];then
	CPU_ARCH=x86_64
fi
find ./ -name '*.spec' | xargs sed -i '1 i\%define arch '"$CPU_ARCH"''

for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
    do
        sed -i 's/%{?_tis_dist}/'"$_tis_dist"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
        sed -i 's/%{tis_patch_ver}/'"$tis_patch_ver"'/g' $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
    done

###Clean up rpmbuild/
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/SRPMS/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILD/*
##rm -rf /home/fh/rpmbuild/BUILDROOT/*
##exit
##eeooff
##
###Copy openEuler source code and spec files to 10.127.2.239
##cd $MY_REPO/stx/git
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_code[@]}
##    do
##        tar -zcf $i.tar.gz $i
##        scp $i.tar.gz fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SOURCES/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/git/$i.tar.gz
##    done
##
##for i in ${openEuler_RPM_spec[@]}
##    do
##        scp $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##        rm -f $MY_REPO/stx/packages/openstack/$i
##    done

#build Centos RPMs
cd $MY_REPO_ROOT_DIR
build-pkgs $PKG_LIST
rm -rf ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.src.rpm

###build openEuler RPMs
##ssh fh@10.127.2.239 << eeooff
##set -o errexit
##cd /home/fh/rpmbuild/SPECS/
##rpmbuild -ba *
##set +o errexit
##exit
##eeooff
##if [[ $? -ne 0 ]];then
##    exit 1
##fi
##
### Copy RPMs to 10.132.3.4
##if [ ! $FH_DATE ]; then
##  FH_DATE=`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M`
##fi

if [ $CPU_ARCH == x86_64 ];then
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"
  scp ${MY_BUILD_DIR}/std/rpmbuild/RPMS/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ## scp fh@10.127.2.239:/home/fh/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/*.rpm root@10.132.3.4:/vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages/
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "createrepo /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/"
  ssh root@10.132.3.4 "ln -sfn /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/ /vdd/fitos/3.6/branch/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/fh-repo"
else
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "rm -rf /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE"
  sleep 5
  ssh root@172.16.62.78 "mkdir -p /vdd/fitos/3.6/daily_build/$FITOS_GIT_BRANCH/$FH_DATE/packages"

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
@echo off

set server_ip=%1
set server_user=%2
set server_pwd=%3
set install_path=%4
set cusaplatform_user_dir=%5
set cusaplatform_root_path=%~d0
set cusaagent_folder=CusaDeployAgent
echo "cusaplatform_root_path is: " %cusaplatform_root_path%
echo "cusaplatform_user_dir is: " %cusaplatform_user_dir%

cd /d %~dp0
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform	hirdparty
set local_folder=%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\%cusaagent_folder%_win
:: set remote_folder=\10.170.90.218\D$\CusaDeployAgent
set remote_folder=\%server_ip%\%install_path%$\%cusaagent_folder%
echo "local_folder path: " %local_folder%
echo "remote_folder path: " %remote_folder%
:: D:\software\CusaAllInOne\Cusaplatform\log
set log_file_path=%cusaplatform_user_dir%\log
echo %cd%
echo "-----set args finished!-----"

:: if exist %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log del %cd%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win.log /f /s /q /a
if exist %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log del /F /S /Q %log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log

if not exist %local_folder% (
    echo "error: %local_folder% not exist"
    echo "%local_folder% not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user%
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo " error: net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail"
    echo "net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ %server_pwd% /user:%server_user% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----connect successed!-----"

if exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "%remote_folder% is exist, call stop.bat and delete %remote_folder%"
    %cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%\service\stop.bat"
    ping %server_ip% -n 30 >nul
    rd /S /Q %remote_folder%
)


xcopy %local_folder% %remote_folder% /D /E /Y /H /K /R /I
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail"
    echo "xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
if not exist %remote_folder% (
    echo "error: %remote_folder% is not exist"
    echo "%remote_folder% is not exist">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
echo "-----xcopy %local_folder% to %remote_folder% finished!-----"


if exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip% (
    rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
) else (
    md %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%
)
CALL %local_folder%\service\create-cusaagentxml.bat %server_ip% %install_path%:\%cusaagent_folder%
if not exist %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml (
    echo "error: create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail"
    echo "create %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)

if exist %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml del /S /Q %remote_folder%\service\cusa-agent.xml /f /s /q /a

copy %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml \%server_ip%\%4$\%cusaagent_folder%\service\ /y
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    echo "error: %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail"
    echo "%local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%\cusa-agent.xml to \%server_ip%\%4$\CusaDeployAgent\service\ is fail">>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
rd /S /Q %local_folder%\service	emp_%server_ip%

net use \%server_ip%\%install_path%$ /delete
echo "-----delete connect successed!-----"

%cusaplatform_user_dir%	hirdparty\WMIC.exe /node:%server_ip% /user:%server_user% /password:%server_pwd% process call create "cmd /c D:\CusaDeployAgent\service\start.bat"
if %ERRORLEVEL% gtr 0 (
    set error_msg="call start.bat is fail"
    echo %error_msg%
    echo %error_msg%>%log_file_path%\install_cusaagent_win_to_win_%server_ip%.log
    goto ERROREXIT
)
@echo "-----install cusaagent successed!
exit /b 0

:ERROREXIT
exit /b 1

# under the [CDDL or GPL Version 2] license." If you do not indicate a
# single choice of license, a recipient has the option to distribute
# your version of this file under either the CDDL, the GPL Version 2 or
# to extend the choice of license to its licensees as provided above.
# However, if you add GPL Version 2 code and therefore, elected the GPL
# Version 2 license, then the option applies only if the new code is
# made subject to such option by the copyright holder.
#
# Contributor(s):

#
# resolve symlinks
#

PRG=$0

while [ -h "$PRG" ]; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '^.*-> \(.*\)$' 2>/dev/null`
    if expr "$link" : '^/' 2> /dev/null >/dev/null; then
	PRG="$link"
    else
	PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
    fi
done

progdir=`dirname "$PRG"`
APPNAME=`basename "$PRG"`
cd "$progdir/../"

if [ -f "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

# XXX does not correctly deal with spaces in non-userdir params
args=""

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        userdir="${default_mac_userdir}"
        ;;
    *)
        userdir="${default_userdir}"
        ;;
esac
while [ $# -gt 0 ] ; do
    case "$1" in
        --userdir) shift; if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then userdir="$1"; fi
            ;;
        *) args="$args "$1""
            ;;
    esac
    shift
done

if [ -f "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf ] ; then
    . "${userdir}/etc/$APPNAME".conf
fi

if [ -n "$jdkhome" -a \! -d "$jdkhome" -a -d "$progdir/../$jdkhome" ]; then
    # #74333: permit jdkhome to be defined as relative to app dir
    jdkhome="$progdir/../$jdkhome"
fi

readClusters() {
  if [ -x /usr/ucb/echo ]; then
    echo=/usr/ucb/echo
  else
    echo=echo
  fi
  while read X; do
    if [ "$X" \!= "" ]; then
      $echo "$progdir/../$X"
    fi
  done
}

absolutize_paths() {
    while read path; do
        if [ -d "$path" ]; then
            (cd "$path" 2>/dev/null && pwd)
        else
            echo "$path"
        fi
    done
}

clusters=`(cat "$progdir/../etc/$APPNAME".clusters; echo) | readClusters | absolutize_paths | tr '
' ':'`

if [ ! -z "$extra_clusters" ] ; then
    clusters="$clusters:$extra_clusters"
fi

nbexec=`echo "$progdir"/../platform*/lib/nbexec`

case "`uname`" in
    Darwin*)
        eval exec sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            -J-Xdock:name='"$APPNAME"' \n            '"-J-Xdock:icon=$progdir/../../$APPNAME.icns"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
        ;;
    *)  
       sh=sh
       # #73162: Ubuntu uses the ancient Bourne shell, which does not implement trap well.
       if [ -x /bin/bash ]
       then
           sh=/bin/bash
       fi
       eval exec $sh '"$nbexec"' \n            --jdkhome '"$jdkhome"' \n            --clusters '"$clusters"' \n            --userdir '"${userdir}"' \n            ${default_options} \n            "$args"
       exit 1
        ;;
esac

# License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations
# under the License.

venv=${1:-pep8}
DEFAULT_BRANCH=${ZUUL_BRANCH:-fitos3.3}
MAJOR_BRANCH=${DEFAULT_BRANCH%%-*}

function export_upper_constratints_file {
    export REQUIREMENTS_PIP_LOCATION=git+http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements.git@${MAJOR_BRANCH}#egg=requirements
    export UPPER_CONSTRAINTS_FILE=http://10.132.3.7/fitcloud/requirements/raw/${MAJOR_BRANCH}/upper-constraints.txt
    export NEUTRON_PIP_LOCATION=git+git@10.132.3.7:fitcloud/neutron.git@${ZUUL_BRANCH}#egg=neutron
}
export_upper_constratints_file

virtualenv sdist_check && sdist_check/bin/pip install pbr && sdist_check/bin/python setup.py sdist
sdistrc=$?
rm -rf sdist_check

tox -v -e$venv
rc=$?

[ -e .tox/$venv/bin/pbr ] && freezecmd=pbr || freezecmd=pip

echo "Begin $freezecmd freeze output from test virtualenv:"
echo "======================================================================"
.tox/${venv}/bin/${freezecmd} freeze
echo "======================================================================"

if [ ! $sdistrc ] ; then
    echo "******************************************************************"
    echo "Project cannot create sdist tarball!!!"
    echo "To reproduce this locally, run: 'python setup.py sdist'"
    echo "******************************************************************"
    exit $sdistrc
fi

exit $rc

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash
##############
#if [[ $# != 1 ]]; then
#    echo "please input month number."
#    exit 1
#fi

INPUT_MONTH=$1

MY_PID=$$

#data file
DATA_FILE="/home/.logindata_${MY_PID}"

DAY_OF_MONTH=`date +%d`

#Result file
RESULT_FILE="/home/.time_cnt"
if [ ! -f ${RESULT_FILE} ]; then
  touch ${RESULT_FILE}
fi

if [[ ! -f ${DATA_FILE} ]]; then
    touch ${DATA_FILE}
fi

echo "" > ${RESULT_FILE}
echo "" > ${DATA_FILE}

for (( i = 1; i <= ${INPUT_MONTH}; i++ )); do
    if [[ ${i} == ${INPUT_MONTH} ]]; then
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash |awk '{if ($(NF-4)>"'${DAY_OF_MONTH}'") print;}'| awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    else
        last | grep `date -d '-'${i}' month' +%b`| grep -v reboot | grep -v down | grep -v crash | awk -F '(' '{print $2}' >> $DATA_FILE
    fi
done
sed -i '/^$/d' ${RESULT_FILE}
sed -i '/^$/d' ${DATA_FILE}

let hour_t=0
let min_t=0

while read J

do
  for T in $J
  do
    let hour=0
    let  min=0
    t=$(echo $T | awk -F ')' '{print $1}')
    let hour=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $1}') 2>/dev/null
    let min=10#$(echo $t | awk -F ':' '{print $2}')

    if [ $hour -gt 12 ];then
        continue
    fi

    if [ $hour -eq 0 ];then
      if [ $min -eq 0 ];then
        continue
      fi
    fi

    let hour_t=$hour_t+$hour
    let min_t=$min_t+$min
  done
done < ${DATA_FILE}

if [ $min_t -ge 60 ];then
  let hour_t=$hour_t+$min_t/60
  let min_t=$min_t%60
fi

let time_he=60*$hour_t+$min_t
let login_num=`cat $DATA_FILE|wc -l`

rm -rf ${DATA_FILE}
echo  "$time_he:$login_num"

#!/bin/bash

systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	systemctl stop nmtool_cm_agent.service
fi

systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	systemctl stop nmtool_cm_service.service
fi
systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	systemctl stop nmtool_webservice.service
fi


SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd -- "$( dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" &> /dev/null && pwd )"


cd $SCRIPT_DIR

NMTOOLS_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/..
AGENT_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_agent
SERVICE_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_service
NGINX_DIR=$SERVICE_DIR/thirdparty/nginx

#停止cmagent服务
echo 停止cmagent服务
cd $AGENT_DIR/bin
#chmod 750 stop_nmtool_agent.sh
sh stop_nmtool_agent.sh

#停止cmservice服务
echo 停止cmservice服务
cd $SERVICE_DIR/bin
#chmod 750 stop_nmtool_service.sh
sh stop_nmtool_service.sh

#停止nginx
echo 停止nginx
cd $NGINX_DIR/bin
#chmod 750 stop_nmtool_webservice.sh
sh stop_nmtool_webservice.sh

  start /b %JAVAW_CMD% -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%" 
)
exit
::CALL java -jar "%ROOT_DIR%\lib\%PACKAGE_NAME%"

POPD

	exit 0
fi

data=`gcc -v 2>&1`
if [[ $data =~ "gcc version" ]]||[[ $data =~ "gcc 版本" ]]
then
  echo 安装了gcc
else

  #rpm -Uvh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent/tools/gcc/*.rpm --nodeps --force

#source ${UNM_ROOT}/server/tool/unmvars.sh

#unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH

#chmod 777 nmtool_cm_agent.service

then

source /etc/profile

rm -r /user/local/nginx

chkconfig --del passtart.server

/etc/init.d/unmstop.server
/etc/init.d/unmtoolstop.server
# /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server stop

$UNM_ROOT/script/killAllProcess.sh

result=$(cat /etc/SuSE-release | grep "VERSION = 12" )
if [[ "$result" != "" ]] ;then
     version="12"
else
     version="11"
fi
if [[ "$version" = "12" ]] ;then
    systemctl disable unm2000.service
    systemctl disable unmtool.service 
    # systemctl disable tomcat.service
else
    chkconfig -del unmstart.server
    chkconfig -del unmtoolstart.server
    # chkconfig -del tomcat.service
fi

#cusaÐ¶ÔØ±ß³µ

grep "iscusa=true" $revisionfile>>/dev/nul
if [ $? -eq 0 ];then
	sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/sidecar/bin/uninstall_sidecar_service.sh
fi

# Ð¶ÔØ¹ÜÀí¹¤¾ß
sh $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/scripts/uninstall_nmtool.sh

#Ð¶ÔØnginx

if [[ $deploymode -eq 1 || $deploymode -eq 2 ]];then
chmod 777 $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
#Ð¶ÔØjetty
sh $UNM_ROOT/jetty/uninstalljetty.sh
fi

cd $UNM_ROOT/script
# rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtomcat.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unm.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstart.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmstop.server
rm -f /etc/init.d/unmtool.server
